claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Tree Form needs activation phases to target the staff itself after it is planted in an unoccupied space, rather than incorrectly attaching the transform to self.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "You can take a Magic action to plant one end of the staff in earth in an unoccupied space and expend 1 charge to transform the staff into a healthy tree."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.last_charge_suppresses_magic
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The last-charge rider does not destroy the item; it removes the item's magical properties and leaves behind a mundane Quarterstaff.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff loses its properties and becomes a nonmagical Quarterstaff."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: item_transform_revert_fall_rider
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The tree-form lifecycle needs a revert-triggered rider that causes creatures in the transformed tree to fall when it becomes a staff again.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Any creature in the tree falls when the tree reverts to a staff."
